in_marathi.name: Adish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adi means 'beginning' or 'first'. Sh means 'that' or 'this'. Together, Adish can be interpreted as 'the beginning of that' or 'the first of this'.
